cohort: The cohort consisted of 683 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) admitted to Wenzhou Medical University Affiliated Second Hospital between January 2019 and December 2021.
finding: Patients with GDM with BFP >=33% were more likely to experience unfavourable pregnancy outcomes, undergo caesarean section, and develop macrosomia, with the combination of BMI and classified BFP offering improved prediction for abnormal blood pressure and caesarean section.
mod_finding: Higher BFP and BMI were significant predictors for caesarean section in patients with GDM.
